gate_type: ACCELERATED IMPLEMENTATION GATE — Shared Hierarchical UI Primitives (G6)
objective: Implement shared hierarchical UI primitives: a small read-only UI-facing structural context model derived from the accepted G1 Workspace/StructuralPath authority, a reusable plain-JS/HTML/CSS hierarchy navigator and context breadcrumb primitive, and additive integration seams for the TIPA ASSY view (Frame A/B) and the continuous dashboard — preserving the ARCH-04 distinction (structural hierarchy = containment; Inspector = object-centric; Monitoring = scope-centric), preserving ASSY/continuous domain rendering and behavior, and implementing NO G7 run-control/replay and no G8+.
explicit_non_objectives: No G7 run-control/replay/orchestration API or semantics
No G8+ / G9 semantic binding / G10 SH-WTP
No full UI rewrite of ASSY or continuous dashboards
No frontend framework migration (plain FastAPI + static HTML/CSS/JS only)
No new global navigation/product UX model beyond ARCH-04
No inventing plant structure for the continuous workspace beyond available authority
No runtime state mutation through the hierarchy/context model
No flattening ASSY into the continuous dashboard and no reinterpretation of hydraulic/thermal variant as structural hierarchy
forbidden_actions: Rewrite ASSY UI or continuous dashboard
Create a second hierarchy model not derived from G1 StructuralPath
Treat bare local ids as canonical lookup authority
Fabricate PIM canonical identity or run/scenario/provenance context
Mutate runtime state through the hierarchy/context model
Invent plant structure for the continuous workspace
stop_conditions: Correct implementation requires a new global navigation/product UX model not frozen by ARCH-04
Continuous workspace hierarchy cannot be represented truthfully without inventing plant structure
ASSY UI must be substantially rewritten rather than additively adapted
G1 structural identity must be weakened or replaced
Scope selection requires new run/scenario lifecycle semantics
Implementation requires G7 run-control/replay, G8+, G9 semantic binding, or G10 SH-WTP runtime decisions

Container-only vs executable capability represented correctly
Path-qualified selection; no ambiguous bare-id authority
TIPA hierarchy renders exactly Workspace TIPA -> ASSY -> six sub-lines
Selecting ASSY-SLxx maps to same existing sub-line context without resetting/reconstructing runtime
Structural hierarchy selection does not change ASSY domain semantics
Continuous view retains existing process/telemetry behavior and does not invent hierarchy beyond available authority
Inspector object context and Monitoring scope context remain distinct
G1-G5 semantics + ASSY oracle + continuous baselines remain green
Working tree clean and branch/head pushed
